image_description: A European fire salamander (Salamandra salamandra) is shown from a top-down perspective, resting on a dark, wet substrate of decomposing leaves and twigs. The salamander has a glossy black body with distinctive irregular yellow spots and patches along its back and sides. The body is elongated and cylindrical, with short limbs visible. The tail extends behind the body, also featuring yellow markings. The surrounding environment appears to be a moist forest floor with dark organic matter.
